entries.label: SaintLogic — salle de Harab Serap
entries.scene: The actual Harab Serap boss room in Metal Gear AC!D2. Recreate only the architecture: teal-blue floor, long waist-height angled control-console banks with dense dark keys and small panel lights, pale yellow luminous horizontal strips, large luminous yellow-green square translucent wall panels separated by black uprights, dark green equipment cabinets. The room is a narrow control room/server laboratory with flat floor and plain black/green industrial walls, as shown. All bright blue/yellow movement squares are gameplay overlay and must be removed. Omit the gorilla and people. Preserve the saturated cel-shaded PSP color design, clean angular surfaces and the specific yellow-green rear wall illumination.
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE opaque wide 16:9 static fighting-game stage background plate for CQC, closely grounded in the supplied original PSP/game screenshots. Input images are REFERENCE SCREENSHOTS or chronological reference contact sheets only. Output one continuous environment, never a grid or collage. The room is a narrow control room/server laboratory with flat floor and plain black/green industrial walls, as shown. All bright blue/yellow movement squares are gameplay overlay and must be removed. notes: Salle Harab Serap contrôlée : consoles inclinées, mur lumineux jaune-vert, sol bleu-vert ; aucune grille de déplacement.
